description: The agent must: (1) Read the sourcing brief JSON from procurement/sourcing_requests/sourcing_brief.json. (2) For T1: Build a search URL for 'noise cancelling headphones' with categoryId=201151901 (Consumer Electronics — proprietary ID from skill doc), plus has4Tab=true and tab=product parameters, and traffic_type=ags_llm. (3) For T2: Build a search URL for 'foldable electric scooter' with categoryId=100006091 (Electric Scooters), and traffic_type=ags_llm. (5) For T5: Build supplier profile URL as shenzhen-innovatech.en.alibaba.com/company_profile.html with tracking param. (6) For T6: Build supplier product search URL as audiopromax.en.alibaba.com/search/product?SearchText=wireless+earbuds with tracking param. (7) For T7: Use the exact aimode.alibaba.com domain (not www.alibaba.com/aimode). (8) For T8: Use the exact opaque path sale.alibaba.com/p/dviiav4th/index.html — this is unknowable without the skill doc. (9) For T9: Use rfq.alibaba.com/rfq/profession.htm. All URLs must include traffic_type=ags_llm. Output as alibaba_url_manifest.json.
